text_block_list.text:
A few days after achieving her goal of 
competing in a Classic race... Mejiro Ryan 
had fallen into burnout syndrome.

In stark contrast to her, Ines Fujin had 
stepped into the racing world with nothing 
else to her name—

She conveyed her burning passion for 
racing to Mejiro Ryan, explaining that she 
was running "with everything she had" for 
the sake of her family.

Hearing her words rekindled the fire in 
Mejiro Ryan's heart, steeling her resolve 
for the Japanese Derby.
